function: CSI feedback: UE encoder compresses the angular-delay CSI, finite-bit shape-gain vector quantization of the latent vector, BS decoder reconstructs the CSI; also multi-rate nested codebooks. p. 1
system: FDD massive MIMO, single cell: BS ULA with Nt=32 antennas, single-antenna UE, OFDM Nc=1024 subcarriers; COST2100 indoor 5.3 GHz and outdoor 300 MHz; no RIS. p. 4
method: VQ-VAE autoencoder with shape-gain vector quantization and nested multi-rate codebooks; trained end-to-end with reconstruction and commitment losses (unsupervised), Adam lr 0.001, 1000 epochs. p. 4
data_channel: COST2100 dataset: indoor picocellular scenario at 5.3 GHz and outdoor rural scenario at 300 MHz; 100000 training, 30000 validation, 20000 testing samples. p. 4
test_conditions: Training, validation and testing are sets drawn from the same COST2100 data; indoor and outdoor results are reported separately for several feedback overheads. p. 4
baselines: Learned only: original VQ-VAE [10] and CSI feedback networks of [2], [15], [16]; no non-learned method is compared. p. 4
metrics: NMSE in dB versus feedback overhead (bits); NMSE versus number of multiplications in the quantization process. p. 4-5
complexity: Quantization complexity order O(2^max{Bmag,Bdir}) versus O(2^B) for original VQ-VAE (p. 3); Fig. 3 plots NMSE against the number of multiplications in quantization (p. 5).
q1_support: p. 4: "using the COST2100 channel model for the indoor picocellular scenario at 5.3 GHz"; COST 2100 is used for training and testing.
q2_support: p. 4: "The sizes of the training, validation, and testing sets are 100000, 30000, and 20000, respectively"; a held-out split of the same data, with no cross-scenario, band or antenna-count test.
q3_support: p. 4: "the DL-based CSI feedback methods developed in [2], [15], and [16]"; all baselines in Table I are learned, and no non-learned method is compared in Table I or Figs. 2-3.
q4_support: p. 3: "is of order O(2max{Bmag ,Bdir } ), significantly smaller than the complexity order O(2B ) of the original VQ-VAE approach"; p. 5 Fig. 3 uses the number of multiplications.
q5_support: p. 4: "using the COST2100 channel model for the indoor picocellular scenario at 5.3 GHz"; the authors generate the data from a channel model, and the letter gives no code or data link, DOI or statement that the dataset is public.
notes: Included, area 2: CSI compression and quantized feedback. All baselines in Table I are DL-based, so q3 is 0. For q5 the reviewer may check whether the COST2100 indoor and outdoor data count as a public dataset, because the paper does not call it public. Table I read from the page image (p. 4). The title and DOI on p. 1 match the work.
